summary: Test-and-clear helper for a single global refresh flag. If byte_7CD2A0 is clear it returns 0 without touching it; otherwise it clears the flag and returns 1, so each set flag is consumed exactly once by the poller (the known caller is ConditionalChain).

operations.description: Guard on byte_7CD2A0: when the flag is clear (0) the function returns 0 and does not clear it.
Return 1 when the flag was set (and is now consumed), or 0 when it was already clear.

unresolved: Which subsystem sets byte_7CD2A0 and what re-evaluation it requests is not established; the single known consumer is ConditionalChain (0x00475570).
